name: t3-street-annex
js: (() => { const C = window.CITY, a = C.worldFromLatLon(43.6662, -79.4040); const r = C.nearestRoads(a.x, a.z, 80)[0]; const nx = -r.dz, nz = r.dx, off = r.road.w / 2 + 2.5; window.__CITY_APP.teleportTo(r.px + nx * off, r.pz + nz * off, Math.atan2(r.dx, r.dz)); window.__CITY_APP.selectCamera('chase', true); })()
